typography.rules: Headings must use Manrope with tracking-tight. Tabular data must use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility.

colors.rule: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI must be monochrome. Orange is reserved STRICTLY for the 'Save Changes' button, the active tab underline, and the left border of the expanded ingredient row. No background gradients.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB on all grid cells. Table must look like a clean, dense spreadsheet.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-sm (2px) for inputs and buttons. Sharp edges.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None on the grid. shadow-sm on the header/toolbar if sticky. shadow-md on dropdowns only.

grids_and_layouts.philosophy: Dense, functional, scanable. Optimize for data correlation.
grids_and_layouts.header: flex justify-between items-center py-4 px-6 bg-white border-b border-gray-200
grids_and_layouts.tabs: flex gap-8 px-6 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 text-sm font-medium
grids_and_layouts.toolbar: flex justify-between items-center py-3 px-6 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 gap-4
grids_and_layouts.data_grid_container: bg-white mx-6 my-4 border border-gray-200 rounded-sm overflow-hidden overflow-x-auto
grids_and_layouts.th: bg-gray-100 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider py-2 px-3 border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0
grids_and_layouts.inputs: h-8 px-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-sm text-sm focus:border-orange-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-orange-500 w-full

motion.hover: Subtle bg-gray-50 on table rows. Buttons slightly darken on hover.
motion.expansion: Immediate toggle using Vanilla JS (toggling a 'hidden' class on the sub-table row), no complex animation needed for this prototype, prioritize functional speed.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:ring-offset-1.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, row toggles, and tabs.

component_instructions.frameworks: HTML5, Tailwind CSS (via CDN), Google Fonts, Phosphor Icons (via unpkg CDN), Vanilla JavaScript.
component_instructions.tailwind_setup: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script><script>tailwind.config = { theme: { extend: { colors: { orange: { 500: '#F97316', 600: '#EA580C' } }, fontFamily: { sans: ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'], display: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'] } } } }</script>
component_instructions.icon_library: <script src="https://unpkg.com/@phosphor-icons/web"></script> use classes like 'ph ph-caret-right', 'ph ph-caret-down', 'ph ph-magnifying-glass'.
structure: 2. Header: 'Recipes Management' (font-display text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight). Right side: Toggle group for 'Card View' / 'Bulk Editor' (Bulk Editor active with dark bg).
4. Toolbar: Search input (left), Right side: Columns dropdown, Excel export icon, Import icon, '+ Add Recipe' button (ghost/outline), 'Save Changes' button (solid orange bg).

5. Data Grid: Table wrapped in a white card. Columns: Chevron (w-8), '#', 'Menu Item / Recipe' (input field w-64), 'Qty' (input w-16), 'Unit' (select), 'Prep Time (m)', 'Cook/Serve (m)', 'Serves', 'Ingredients' (badge), 'Cost (₹)', 'Margin %'.

6. Sub-table logic: When chevron is clicked, the main row chevron changes from ph-caret-right to ph-caret-down. The row immediately following it (which spans all columns via colspan) removes its 'hidden' class to reveal a sub-table of ingredients. Sub-table has columns: Ingredient (select w-48), Quantity (input w-24), Unit (text), Action (Trash icon). Sub-table is wrapped in a div with orange left border.
7. Make 2 rows expanded by default so the user can see the ingredient state immediately upon loading.
component_instructions.js_interactions_script: Write a vanilla JS script at the bottom of the body. Select all chevrons by a class. On click, find the closest tr, toggle the chevron icon, and toggle the 'hidden' class on the nextElementSibling tr (which is the subtable row). Implement a simple search filter that hides trs not matching the input value.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT create a React component. Do NOT put this in src/components.
This must be a self-contained, valid HTML5 file that runs independently in the browser.
Do NOT center align the text globally. Ensure table content is properly aligned (numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned).
Use standard HTML <input>, <select>, <button> elements styled with Tailwind utility classes.
Ensure the recipe name IS the menu item name - they are combined into one column 'Menu Item / Recipe' as explicitly requested.
The Expanded Row MUST feature an orange left border (4px) and a subtle bg-gray-50 background.
Include 'data-testid' on interactive elements. Example: data-testid='recipe-search-input', data-testid='expand-row-btn-1'.
For icons, use Phosphor Icons via script tag. NO AI emojis.
Avoid unnecessary wrappers. Build exactly the structure needed for a high-performance dense UI data grid.
